children.onClick: {{(async () => { await storeValue('apiToken', BearerToken.text || '', false); await storeValue('developmentSubject', DevelopmentSubject.text || '', false); if (!appsmith.store.householdId) { showAlert('Connection saved for this session', 'success'); return; } RestoreSelectedHousehold.run(async () => { const household = Array.isArray(RestoreSelectedHousehold.data) ? RestoreSelectedHousehold.data.find((item) => item.id === appsmith.store.householdId) : undefined; if (household) { await storeValue('householdName', household.display_name, true); showAlert('Connection saved and household restored', 'success'); } else { await removeValue('householdId'); await removeValue('householdName'); showAlert('The saved household is no longer available. Choose another household.', 'error'); navigateTo('Households'); } }, () => showAlert('Connection saved, but the saved household could not be verified', 'error')); })()}}
